# Snapback

> Snapback · Your Mac workspace, exactly how you left it.

Snapback is a modern productivity tool and workspace automation app for macOS that allows users to save and precisely restore entire workspace environments instantly. 
It captures and restores application states, window positions, monitor configurations, and exact z-index (stacking) orders. With a single keyboard shortcut, users can instantly context switch by restoring a perfectly arranged digital workspace across multiple displays.

## Core Features
- **Window Positioning**: Saves the exact location and geometry of all open windows.
- **Z-Index Memory**: Saves the exact stacking order of overlapping windows so the right apps are on top.
- **Multi-Display Mapping**: Accurately maps windows to external displays, even if they are reconnected later.
- **Native macOS Experience**: High-performance, lightweight Swift application built strictly for macOS.
- **One-Click Restoration**: Launch entire project environments (e.g., Code editor + Terminal + Browser + Slack) with a simple hotkey.

## Common Workflows
- **Software Development**: Restore an IDE, local server terminal, API client, and documentation browser.
- **Creative & Video Editing**: Restore the timeline, assets bins, and preview monitors exactly where they belong.
- **Deep Work**: Snap into a non-distracting environment with essential apps taking center stage.

## Platform & Availability
- **OS Required**: macOS (Apple Silicon natively supported, compatible with Intel via Rosetta).
- **Website**: https://snapbackapp.com
